Dan Burros.fact: Burros became fascinated by and began to collect German war materials and paraphernalia, though in his first two years of high school this was initially not Nazi-related. Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: By his junior year of high school, he displayed pictures of Nazi military officials in his room and argued _____ was misunderstood
Dan Burros.fact: By his junior year of high school, he displayed pictures of Nazi military officials in his room and argued Nazi Germany was misunderstood.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: In _____, he called a Jewish friend of his a "Jew bastard", after which they never spoke again; this was, to his friends' knowledge, the first antisemitic thing he had said
Dan Burros.fact: In 1954, he called a Jewish friend of his a "Jew bastard", after which they never spoke again; this was, to his friends' knowledge, the first antisemitic thing he had said.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He later told his friends that college was for _____
Dan Burros.fact: He later told his friends that college was for Jews.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Burros enlisted in the National Guard in his senior year of high school on August 12, _____, joining the Company I, 165th Infantry Regiment
Dan Burros.fact: Burros enlisted in the National Guard in his senior year of high school on August 12, 1954, joining the Company I, 165th Infantry Regiment.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He was discharged from the Guard in August _____ to join the United States Army, enlisting on August 18 for a six year term
Dan Burros.fact: He was discharged from the Guard in August 1955 to join the United States Army, enlisting on August 18 for a six year term.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He initially served in the 364th _____, then the 187th Airborne Infantry Regiment and finally the 327th Infantry Regiment, at, successively, Fort Dix, Fort Bragg, and Fort Campbell
Dan Burros.fact: Burros enlisted in the National Guard in his senior year of high school on August 12, 1954, joining the Company I, 165th Infantry Regiment. He initially served in the 364th Infantry Regiment, then the 187th Airborne Infantry Regiment and finally the 327th Infantry Regiment, at, successively, Fort Dix, Fort Bragg, and Fort Campbell.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Burros was one of the soldiers who forcibly integrated Little Rock Central High School in September _____
Dan Burros.fact: Burros was one of the soldiers who forcibly integrated Little Rock Central High School in September 1957.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: As a result, he was sent to a psychiatrist in the _____
Dan Burros.fact: As a result, he was sent to a psychiatrist in the Army.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Several years later Burros claimed instead that he had undergone psychological treatment while serving for "sadistic tendencies and _____ leanings", after he strangled an eagle
Dan Burros.fact: Several years later Burros claimed instead that he had undergone psychological treatment while serving for "sadistic tendencies and Nazi leanings", after he strangled an eagle.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He later claimed he left the army in disgust after _____
Dan Burros.fact: He later claimed he left the army in disgust after Little Rock.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He began work July 10, _____, for the Queens Public Library, operating office machines and printing cataloguing cards
Dan Burros.fact: He was discharged under honorable conditions on March 14, 1958, less than an honorable discharge, which was ascribed to "reasons of unsuitability, character, and behavior disorder". He began work July 10, 1958, for the Queens Public Library, operating office machines and printing cataloguing cards.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He had a reputation as a good worker, but would talk about neo-_____ topics to his coworkers at length
Dan Burros.fact: He had a reputation as a good worker, but would talk about neo-Nazi topics to his coworkers at length. Burros began expressing an interest in neo-Nazi activism in December 1958 and contacted several neo-Nazi groups.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: This lasted for a year and a half before he quit in January _____ over a printing dispute; Burros refused to obey his boss's instructions for how to handle catalog cards
Dan Burros.fact: This lasted for a year and a half before he quit in January 1960 over a printing dispute; Burros refused to obey his boss's instructions for how to handle catalog cards.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Soon after he found work operating a multigraph for the U.S. _____
Dan Burros.fact: Soon after he found work operating a multigraph for the U.S. Navigation Company.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Burros began expressing an interest in neo-Nazi activism in December _____ and contacted several neo-Nazi groups
Dan Burros.fact: Burros began expressing an interest in neo-Nazi activism in December 1958 and contacted several neo-Nazi groups.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He signed his letters with a red swastika and the name of the _____; he was the sole member of the supposed organization
Dan Burros.fact: He signed his letters with a red swastika and the name of the American National Socialist Party; he was the sole member of the supposed organization.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He collected _____ paraphernalia and often drew detailed art of Jews dying
Dan Burros.fact: Burros began expressing an interest in neo-Nazi activism in December 1958 and contacted several neo-Nazi groups. He collected Nazi paraphernalia and often drew detailed art of Jews dying.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Burros became a known figure among the letter-sending Nazi underground, and through correspondence came into contact with several _____ ex-military officers
Dan Burros.fact: Burros became a known figure among the letter-sending Nazi underground, and through correspondence came into contact with several German ex-military officers.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He donated money to racist causes, including avowed racist _____, who sent the money back as he considered Burros too pro-Nazi
Dan Burros.fact: He donated money to racist causes, including avowed racist John Kasper, who sent the money back as he considered Burros too pro-Nazi.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He was briefly a member of the British National Party in early _____, receiving a membership card
Dan Burros.fact: He was briefly a member of the British National Party in early 1960, receiving a membership card. The party's leader, George Lincoln Rockwell, recalled that Burros had made contact with the party in 1960, first contacting James K. Warner.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: The party's leader, George Lincoln Rockwell, recalled that Burros had made contact with the party in _____, first contacting James K. Warner
Dan Burros.fact: He was briefly a member of the British National Party in early 1960, receiving a membership card. The party's leader, George Lincoln Rockwell, recalled that Burros had made contact with the party in 1960, first contacting James K. Warner.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He was especially interested in the Nazi uniforms, and claimed on the application form that he was ethnically _____
Dan Burros.fact: He was especially interested in the Nazi uniforms, and claimed on the application form that he was ethnically German.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He was accepted and took the "_____'s Oath"
Dan Burros.fact: He was accepted and took the "Trooper's Oath".

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: At the same time, he found work at the _____ of Commerce operating a multilith, a kind of printing press
Dan Burros.fact: At the same time, he found work at the United States Chamber of Commerce operating a multilith, a kind of printing press.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He claimed he had learned _____ to better "investigate the enemy"
Dan Burros.fact: He claimed he had learned Hebrew to better "investigate the enemy".

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: His heritage was unknown in the ANP, but some members were suspicious of him, and he was occasionally teased for supposedly looking _____
Dan Burros.fact: His heritage was unknown in the ANP, but some members were suspicious of him, and he was occasionally teased for supposedly looking Jewish. ANP member Matt Koehl later said Burros had not looked Jewish and said Burros probably had some amount of "Aryan blood".

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: ANP member _____ later said Burros had not looked Jewish and said Burros probably had some amount of "Aryan blood"
Dan Burros.fact: ANP member Matt Koehl later said Burros had not looked Jewish and said Burros probably had some amount of "Aryan blood".

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Rockwell appreciated Burros, impressed by his fervent _____ and artistic and mechanical skills; he was seen by Rockwell as too fanatical, but unlike many prospective members, had valuable skills
Dan Burros.fact: Rockwell appreciated Burros, impressed by his fervent Nazism and artistic and mechanical skills; he was seen by Rockwell as too fanatical, but unlike many prospective members, had valuable skills.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Burros worked as the ANP's printer for their propaganda, including bumper stickers and antisemitic soap wrappers, largely sold through mail-order in the _____ magazine
Dan Burros.fact: Burros worked as the ANP's printer for their propaganda, including bumper stickers and antisemitic soap wrappers, largely sold through mail-order in the National Socialist Bulletin magazine.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: One of the items of merchandise printed by Burros was the "_____" (which was to be given to a Jew who would be last in line for the gas chamber)
Dan Burros.fact: One of the items of merchandise printed by Burros was the "Jew Pass" (which was to be given to a Jew who would be last in line for the gas chamber).

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: In one instance, a _____ teenager from Arlington arrived at their headquarters and said he wanted to join the party
Dan Burros.fact: In one instance, a Jewish teenager from Arlington arrived at their headquarters and said he wanted to join the party.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Several ANP members, including _____, thought it would be a good publicity stunt to allow it, but Burros was staunchly opposed to any Jews joining the party
Dan Burros.fact: Several ANP members, including Rockwell, thought it would be a good publicity stunt to allow it, but Burros was staunchly opposed to any Jews joining the party.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Burros was known for his especially violent antisemitism, to a degree author _____ called "almost psychotic"
Dan Burros.fact: Burros was known for his especially violent antisemitism, to a degree author Kevin Coogan called "almost psychotic".

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Burros carried a bar of soap labeled "Made from the finest _____ fat", and often talked about creating torture devices to use on Jews
Dan Burros.fact: Burros carried a bar of soap labeled "Made from the finest Jewish fat", and often talked about creating torture devices to use on Jews. A specific, favorite fantasy of Burros involved the keys of a piano being modified to deliver electric shocks via wires attached to the Jewish victim of their choice, which the torturer would play to make the victim scream in different keys.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He expressed contempt for _____ as a "doctrine of weakness" and in some letters he wrote, he talked of a "Nordic religion"
Dan Burros.fact: He expressed contempt for Christianity as a "doctrine of weakness" and in some letters he wrote, he talked of a "Nordic religion".

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: After several neo-Nazis complained the ANP members were worse fed than the party dog, _____, Burros suggested that they eat him, which some members believed was a genuine threat
Dan Burros.fact: After several neo-Nazis complained the ANP members were worse fed than the party dog, Gas Chamber, Burros suggested that they eat him, which some members believed was a genuine threat.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: They asked _____ to take control of the National Socialist Bulletin from Warner, which failed but incensed Warner
Dan Burros.fact: They asked Rockwell to take control of the National Socialist Bulletin from Warner, which failed but incensed Warner. This resulted in a fit of rage from Burros, who had to be calmed down by Rockwell telling Warner to wait for a replacement photo.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: This resulted in a fit of rage from Burros, who had to be calmed down by _____ telling Warner to wait for a replacement photo
Dan Burros.fact: They asked Rockwell to take control of the National Socialist Bulletin from Warner, which failed but incensed Warner. This resulted in a fit of rage from Burros, who had to be calmed down by Rockwell telling Warner to wait for a replacement photo.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: As revenge, _____ told Burros a photo of his would be removed from the Bulletin
Dan Burros.fact: They asked Rockwell to take control of the National Socialist Bulletin from Warner, which failed but incensed Warner. As revenge, Warner told Burros a photo of his would be removed from the Bulletin.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: In _____, ANP security officer Roger Foss conducted background checks on all ANP members; Rockwell said that a refusal to comply with the background check meant being kicked out of the party
Dan Burros.fact: In 1960, ANP security officer Roger Foss conducted background checks on all ANP members; Rockwell said that a refusal to comply with the background check meant being kicked out of the party.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Burros told _____ he could give neither his background information nor home address, even if it was given confidentially
Dan Burros.fact: In 1960, ANP security officer Roger Foss conducted background checks on all ANP members; Rockwell said that a refusal to comply with the background check meant being kicked out of the party. Burros told Foss he could give neither his background information nor home address, even if it was given confidentially.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: In response, party secretary _____ suggested Burros be kicked out of the party
Dan Burros.fact: In response, party secretary James K. Warner suggested Burros be kicked out of the party.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Warner and Foss went to _____, who said he needed Burros as his printer, and directed them to make an exception for the background check
Dan Burros.fact: In 1960, ANP security officer Roger Foss conducted background checks on all ANP members; Rockwell said that a refusal to comply with the background check meant being kicked out of the party. Warner and Foss went to Rockwell, who said he needed Burros as his printer, and directed them to make an exception for the background check.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: This led to lengthy arguments; Foss called it a security risk, and called Burros a "sadist" and a "nut" who was obviously _____
Dan Burros.fact: This led to lengthy arguments; Foss called it a security risk, and called Burros a "sadist" and a "nut" who was obviously Jewish. It is unknown if Rockwell was unaware that he was Jewish, or knew that he was Jewish and did not care.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: It is unknown if _____ was unaware that he was Jewish, or knew that he was Jewish and did not care
Dan Burros.fact: Warner and Foss went to Rockwell, who said he needed Burros as his printer, and directed them to make an exception for the background check. Rockwell nevertheless refused to remove Burros.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: On July 3, 1960, after a fight at a Rockwell speech, several ANP members, including Rockwell and Burros, and _____, were arrested for disorderly conduct
Dan Burros.fact: On July 3, 1960, after a fight at a Rockwell speech, several ANP members, including Rockwell and Burros, and their opponents, were arrested for disorderly conduct.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Due to the subsequent legal proceedings, _____ was involuntarily committed to a psychiatric hospital for observation for thirty days
Dan Burros.fact: Rockwell nevertheless refused to remove Burros. It is unknown if Rockwell was unaware that he was Jewish, or knew that he was Jewish and did not care.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: The next day, Burros, Foss and Patler all picketed the _____ advocating for Rockwell to be freed
Dan Burros.fact: The next day, Burros, Foss and Patler all picketed the White House advocating for Rockwell to be freed.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: After they had spent several hours picketing, _____ and Burros were arrested due to the warrant and were imprisoned
Dan Burros.fact: On July 26, 1960, the day before Rockwell was committed, Patler and Burros went to the Anti-Defamation League (ADL) headquarters, where they asked for copies of the ADL Bulletin, placed swastika stickers in the elevator and wrote the words "we are back". The next day, Burros, Foss and Patler all picketed the White House advocating for Rockwell to be freed.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: When he returned, he suspended both _____ and Burros until the outcome of their trial, but then reinstated them due to his belief in their innocence
Dan Burros.fact: After they had spent several hours picketing, Patler and Burros were arrested due to the warrant and were imprisoned. Patler's wife raised bail from a Jewish bondsman.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: At their trial on _____ 20, they were found guilty and sentenced by a jury to a $100 fine or a 10-day jail sentence and six months suspended
Dan Burros.fact: At their trial on September 20, they were found guilty and sentenced by a jury to a $100 fine or a 10-day jail sentence and six months suspended.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: The Chamber of Commerce fired Burros over his ANP membership in February _____
Dan Burros.fact: The Chamber of Commerce fired Burros over his ANP membership in February 1961.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: In May of that year, Burros was one of the ANP members to tour in the party's _____ protesting the Freedom Riders
Dan Burros.fact: In May of that year, Burros was one of the ANP members to tour in the party's Hate Bus protesting the Freedom Riders.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: When Jim Jones, the leader of the Peoples Temple, wrote to the _____ requesting a meeting over racial matters, it was Burros who wrote back for the party
Dan Burros.fact: When Jim Jones, the leader of the Peoples Temple, wrote to the American Nazi Party requesting a meeting over racial matters, it was Burros who wrote back for the party.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Burros was promoted to lieutenant and national secretary of the party in July _____, making him the third highest-ranking person in the party, behind only Rockwell himself and J. V. Morgan
Dan Burros.fact: Burros was promoted to lieutenant and national secretary of the party in July 1961, making him the third highest-ranking person in the party, behind only Rockwell himself and J. V. Morgan.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He authored the ANP's _____'s Manual
Dan Burros.fact: He authored the ANP's Official Stormtrooper's Manual.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: It was the ANP's official manual, distributed to all group recruits, dedicated to _____, with design by Patler
Dan Burros.fact: It was the ANP's official manual, distributed to all group recruits, dedicated to Horst Wessel, with design by Patler.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: As a result of their behavior, _____ grew to dislike the trio
Dan Burros.fact: As a result of their behavior, Roger Foss grew to dislike the trio.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: The three later got _____ demoted over a disciplinary infraction, leading to Foss leaving ANP headquarters
Dan Burros.fact: As a result of their behavior, Roger Foss grew to dislike the trio. The three later got Foss demoted over a disciplinary infraction, leading to Foss leaving ANP headquarters.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Burros and _____ had also edited the Official Stormtrooper's Manual in a manner Rockwell viewed as self-promotional
Dan Burros.fact: Burros and Patler had also edited the Official Stormtrooper's Manual in a manner Rockwell viewed as self-promotional. Burros and Patler left without notice November 5, 1961, and moved to New York.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Burros and Patler left without notice November 5, _____, and moved to New York
Dan Burros.fact: Burros and Patler left without notice November 5, 1961, and moved to New York.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: In New York, they launched a magazine called _____! which was "dedicated to the annihilation of the enemies of the White people"
Dan Burros.fact: In New York, they launched a magazine called Kill! which was "dedicated to the annihilation of the enemies of the White people". The first issue of Kill! displays on its back a noose and the words "Impeach the Traitor John F. Kennedy for Giving Aid and Comfort to the Enemies of the U.S.A."; the same issue also featured a Burros-written editorial entitled "The Importance of Killing".

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Its first issue was published in July _____, edited by Burros
Dan Burros.fact: Its first issue was published in July 1962, edited by Burros.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: The magazine was an outlet for attacking other members of the movement and was described by _____ as "viciously racist and anti-Semitic"
Dan Burros.fact: The magazine was an outlet for attacking other members of the movement and was described by Jeffrey Kaplan as "viciously racist and anti-Semitic".

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He attacked _____ in the magazine, saying that "without the swastika, Rockwell would be nothing" and calling him a "nigger loving liberal"
Dan Burros.fact: He attacked Rockwell in the magazine, saying that "without the swastika, Rockwell would be nothing" and calling him a "nigger loving liberal".

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Their party was functionally a duplicate of the _____, and never had more than a few members
Dan Burros.fact: Their party was functionally a duplicate of the American Nazi Party, and never had more than a few members.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: They were so poor that they could not afford _____ uniforms, disappointing Burros, and although they picketed leftist meetings and movie theaters, they received little attention
Dan Burros.fact: Their party was functionally a duplicate of the American Nazi Party, and never had more than a few members. They were so poor that they could not afford Nazi uniforms, disappointing Burros, and although they picketed leftist meetings and movie theaters, they received little attention.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He spent his time collecting _____ memorabilia
Dan Burros.fact: Their party was functionally a duplicate of the American Nazi Party, and never had more than a few members. They were so poor that they could not afford Nazi uniforms, disappointing Burros, and although they picketed leftist meetings and movie theaters, they received little attention.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: At the time, Burros worked at a _____-owned printing company and did not discuss his views while at work
Dan Burros.fact: At the time, Burros worked at a Jewish-owned printing company and did not discuss his views while at work. Despite the risk of it outing him as Jewish, he often visited his parents in the neighborhood where he was recognized as Jewish.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Despite the risk of it outing him as _____, he often visited his parents in the neighborhood where he was recognized as Jewish
Dan Burros.fact: At the time, Burros worked at a Jewish-owned printing company and did not discuss his views while at work. Despite the risk of it outing him as Jewish, he often visited his parents in the neighborhood where he was recognized as Jewish.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Burros informed on members of other extremist groups in _____ to the police; his information was rarely helpful
Dan Burros.fact: Burros informed on members of other extremist groups in New York to the police; his information was rarely helpful.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: The American National Party dissolved about a year later and the magazine ended after four issues, when _____ and Burros had a falling-out
Dan Burros.fact: The American National Party dissolved about a year later and the magazine ended after four issues, when Patler and Burros had a falling-out. When Patler was arrested and jailed for picketing a rally, he started a hunger strike in jail.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He was also annoyed when Burros decided to watch football instead of picketing _____'s funeral with him
Dan Burros.fact: He was also annoyed when Burros decided to watch football instead of picketing Eleanor Roosevelt's funeral with him.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Burros ultimately stayed in _____ and Patler returned to the American Nazi Party
Dan Burros.fact: Burros ultimately stayed in New York and Patler returned to the American Nazi Party.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Patler murdered Rockwell in _____
Dan Burros.fact: Patler murdered Rockwell in 1967.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He was especially interested in _____'s book Imperium which he read repeatedly and called "the Bible of the American right-wing"
Dan Burros.fact: He donated money to racist causes, including avowed racist John Kasper, who sent the money back as he considered Burros too pro-Nazi. He was briefly a member of the British National Party in early 1960, receiving a membership card.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Burros joined the neo-Nazi National Renaissance Party in early _____
Dan Burros.fact: Burros joined the neo-Nazi National Renaissance Party in early 1963.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: The leader of the party, _____, was also interested in Yockey; while Madole hated Rockwell, he had many of the same views
Dan Burros.fact: The leader of the party, James H. Madole, was also interested in Yockey; while Madole hated Rockwell, he had many of the same views.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Impressed by Burros's ideological fervor, Madole promoted him to the party's high-ranking _____
Dan Burros.fact: Impressed by Burros's ideological fervor, Madole promoted him to the party's high-ranking Security Echelon. Burros wrote for the group's National Renaissance Bulletin, and also edited the Security Echelon's magazine, the SE Guard.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: However, _____ did not trust Burros, worrying he was a spy for Rockwell
Dan Burros.fact: The leader of the party, James H. Madole, was also interested in Yockey; while Madole hated Rockwell, he had many of the same views. Impressed by Burros's ideological fervor, Madole promoted him to the party's high-ranking Security Echelon.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Burros wrote for the group's _____, and also edited the Security Echelon's magazine, the SE Guard
Dan Burros.fact: Burros wrote for the group's National Renaissance Bulletin, and also edited the Security Echelon's magazine, the SE Guard.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: The NRP members saw themselves as more sophisticated racists than the _____, and at times found Burros's extreme views embarrassing, but nevertheless found him useful
Dan Burros.fact: The NRP members saw themselves as more sophisticated racists than the American Nazi Party, and at times found Burros's extreme views embarrassing, but nevertheless found him useful.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: He was also the editor of a newsletter, _____, sometimes just the Nazi Fascist
Dan Burros.fact: He was also the editor of a newsletter, The International Nazi Fascist, sometimes just the Nazi Fascist. The International Nazi Fascist was later replaced by The Free American, a newspaper based out of New York City.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: The International Nazi Fascist was later replaced by _____, a newspaper based out of New York City
Dan Burros.fact: The International Nazi Fascist was later replaced by The Free American, a newspaper based out of New York City. The Free American became popular with fascists internationally.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: The paper discussed Nazi and fascist topics, advertised other neo-Nazi movements, and dated its issues by years since _____'s birth, YF, for "Year Führer"
Dan Burros.fact: The paper discussed Nazi and fascist topics, advertised other neo-Nazi movements, and dated its issues by years since Adolf Hitler's birth, YF, for "Year Führer".

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: During the investigation into the _____ assassination of John F. Kennedy, it was found that Lee Harvey Oswald had Burros and Rockwell in his address book, which was printed in exhibit Volume XVI of th
Dan Burros.fact: During the investigation into the 1963 assassination of John F. Kennedy, it was found that Lee Harvey Oswald had Burros and Rockwell in his address book, which was printed in exhibit Volume XVI of the Warren Commission.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Following the assassination, Burros wore a button emblazoned "_____"
Dan Burros.fact: Following the assassination, Burros wore a button emblazoned "Lee Harvey Oswald Fan Club".

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: In July _____, Burros and other NRP members were jailed after getting into a fight with Congress of Racial Equality (CORE) protestors at a diner
Dan Burros.fact: In July 1963, Burros and other NRP members were jailed after getting into a fight with Congress of Racial Equality (CORE) protestors at a diner.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: They were not arrested for the fight, but after they went to file a complaint against the _____ members, a police detective found a stash of weapons and racist literature in their car
Dan Burros.fact: In July 1963, Burros and other NRP members were jailed after getting into a fight with Congress of Racial Equality (CORE) protestors at a diner. They were not arrested for the fight, but after they went to file a complaint against the CORE members, a police detective found a stash of weapons and racist literature in their car.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: His name was filed in the records of police in Germany and the _____, and he received letters from other neo-Nazis expressing their admiration
Dan Burros.fact: His name was filed in the records of police in Germany and the United Kingdom, and he received letters from other neo-Nazis expressing their admiration.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Several of his writings were distributed in _____ neo-Nazi meetings
Dan Burros.fact: His name was filed in the records of police in Germany and the United Kingdom, and he received letters from other neo-Nazis expressing their admiration. Several of his writings were distributed in German neo-Nazi meetings.

Dan Burros.subject: Important Days
Dan Burros.question: Come the trial May 4, _____, Burros was sentenced to one to two years at Sing Sing State Prison
Dan Burros.fact: Come the trial May 4, 1964, Burros was sentenced to one to two years at Sing Sing State Prison.
